# Original Bible — Hansam Yang

> Public research pilot v0.4.5. Hebrew display, evidence notes and AI-assisted Korean, English and Spanish translation drafts. Human specialist review pending.

- [Genesis 2:1–25](https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/en/genesis-2/)
- [Genesis 1:1–31](https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/en/genesis-1/)

- [Bible reader and comparison](https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/read/)
- [Update history and publication status](https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/updates/)

- [Separately sourced reading editions](https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/library/catalog.json) — KorRV, ASV 1901, RV1909; upstream Public Domain distributions, not translations by Hansam Yang. Chapter/verse alignment only; source metadata and empty slots retained.
